summary: Tested the bug fix for API status pill showing MongoDB DB name. All 5 test items pass. Backend /api/health returns correct MSSQL values. Frontend pill shows 'MSSQL · RC26MASTERDB'. Wizard loads with 9 steps. Sample file loads. Dashboard 'New Import' navigates to /import/new.
critical_code_review_comments: WizardPage.jsx correctly reads h.mssqlLive and h.mssqlDb (with fallback to h.dbNew) to show 'MSSQL · {mssqlDb}' when configured
/api/health now returns mssqlLive, mssqlDb, dbNew all pointing to MSSQL_DB (RC26MASTERDB) — MongoDB name never exposed
Minor: Playwright pill text check was a timing issue (health API async) — visual screenshot confirms correct pill text

success_rate.frontend: 100% — pill shows 'MSSQL · RC26MASTERDB', 9 steps present, sample file loads (18 rows), New Import → /import/new

context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix verified: pill now shows 'MSSQL · RC26MASTERDB' (green) instead of 'live · retailcliq_import'. Health endpoint verified. 9-step wizard (Source,Preview,Mapping,Suppliers,Masters,Validate,Confirm,Import,Result) loads at /import/new. Sample CSV loads 18 rows with Continue enabled.
rca_of_issue: Root cause was: (1) /api/health previously returned dbNew=MongoDB DB name and mode='live'/'demo' without exposing mssqlLive/mssqlDb fields; (2) WizardPage pill read h.mode and h.dbNew which resolved to MongoDB 'retailcliq_import'. Fix: health endpoint now sets dbNew=MSSQL_DB only when sql_configured, adds explicit mssqlLive and mssqlDb fields; pill logic reads h.mssqlLive and h.mssqlDb.
